patch_description:
Add a deterministic late-stage basin-hopping refinement around the best configuration already found by the broad continuation. The current search keeps only one best checkpoint and stops after its main annealing trajectory; this can leave an asymmetric contact graph close to, but not inside, a better local minimax basin.

The added phase preserves the incumbent, creates several small reproducible asymmetric perturbations of it, and refines every clone using only sharp soft-min/soft-max objectives. This is inexpensive relative to the existing seven full trajectories, directly follows the exact squared-distance ratio objective, and retains every exact-ratio improvement rather than trusting the smoothed objective alone. The first narrow phase can alter the active contact graph while the second sharper phase settles the limiting minimum and diameter contacts.
